method: BASELINE. Seat-neutral core in the act's and the regulations' own terms, with regulative rules where the text states duties, and an applicant seat layer built from it; written straight from the deposited texts with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Kansas Statutes online (Office of Revisor of Statutes, read 2026-10-20; 2025 session laws), K.S.A. 39-702, 39-709, 39-719b, 39-7,124, 39-7,127, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/ksa-39-7-public-assistance-tanf.txt (retrieved 2026-10-19 UTC); with K.A.R. 30-4-100 and 30-4-101 (2022 K.A.R. Volume 3, filed through 2021-12-31) as deposited at ../../../kansas-administrative-regulations-30-4-100-to-30-4-102-tanf-payment-standards/registers/source-bundle/kar-30-4-100-to-30-4-102-tanf-payment-standards.txt.

scope: K.S.A. 39-702(g); 39-709(a)(1), (2); 39-709(b)(3), (5), (6), (8)(B), (D), (G), (9), (10); 39-719b(a); 39-7,124; 39-7,127(a)(1); K.A.R. 30-4-100(b), 30-4-101. Out: the grant after income (K.A.R. 30-4-110 to 113 not deposited), the family cap (39-7,125), drug screening, food assistance, child care and medical assistance.
seat: the applicant (the parent or relative applying for or receiving TANF for a child)
